faqs.question: What is Prashant Kumar Diwakar's key vision for Law Centre-1?
faqs.answer: Prashant Kumar Diwakar's vision is grounded in action, accessibility, and student rights: 24/7 accessible issue redressal, extended 10 PM AC library timings, guaranteed clean RO water, high-speed Wi-Fi, transparent attendance dispute committee, and a dedicated Placement & Moot Court Support Cell.

faqs.question: How does the Issue Redressal system work on this portal?
faqs.answer: Any LC-1 student can submit a campus issue (infrastructure, library, attendance, water, canteen). Every complaint generates a unique ticket ID. Team Prashant Diwakar inspects the issue within 24 hours, takes up the matter directly with the Dean/Administration, and posts transparent updates.

faqs.question: Can students suggest points for the Presidential Manifesto?
faqs.answer: Yes! We believe a manifesto should be written by students, for students. Use the 'Submit Manifesto Suggestion' tab to send your ideas directly to Prashant Diwakar and our drafting committee.

faqs.question: How can I join and volunteer with Team Prashant Diwakar?
faqs.answer: Fill out the 'Join Team Prashant' form on the portal or call our volunteer desk at +91 6206319802. We welcome passionate students from 1st, 2nd, and 3rd year batches as batch coordinators and digital team members.
